title: The Flatline Method
description: Wellness night with Pastor Hollis, founder of a dopamine-detox movement called The Flatline, who teaches that all pleasure is a leak and the highest state is total boredom. Devotees mail away everything they own and pay a monthly fee for The Box, a sealed cardboard cube containing, verifiably, nothing. The converts call in vibrating with joy about how little they feel, which Hollis keeps flagging as a relapse, and Barry just wants someone, anyone, to tell him what is actually in the box.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, we feel nothing. With us is Pastor Hollis, founder of a wellness movement called The Flatline. Hollis, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A movement about feeling nothing. Great. That's just my Tuesdays.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Thank you, flatliner. <p:0.3> You think joy is good. But joy is a leak. Every laugh, every flavor, that's pressure escaping a sealed life. The goal is the seal.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The seal. Now THAT is a real journey, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: And the seal costs money?

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Nine ninety-nine a month, flatliner. You mail us everything that makes you feel anything. <p:0.3> And we mail you back The Box.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay. <p:0.3> What's IN the box?

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Right, but, the box, the physical box, what is inside it?

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Verified nothing, flatliner. Notarized. <p:0.3> We pay an inspector to confirm the box is empty.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Hi Ronnie! Patricia here! <p:0.3> I've been on The Flatline four months and I feel SO nothing right now, I could just SCREAM!

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: That's a leak, flatliner.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Sorry! Sorry. <p:0.3> I'm just SO calm about it, it's THRILLING.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Also a leak.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia, what did you mail them?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Everything, Barry! My piano, my dog, all my photos. <p:0.3> And they sent back The Box and I keep it on the piano. Well. Where the piano WAS.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Yeah, Chad here, forget the dog. <p:0.3> Hollis. What's my margin on the empty box? Like if I buy in at nine ninety-nine, what do empties resell for?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Resell? It's an empty box, Chad, the margin is the box.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: There is a Premium Box, flatliner. <p:0.3> Same nothing. Thicker cardboard. Forty a month.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Premium empty. <p:0.3> Okay, so I arbitrage the spread between Standard Nothing and Premium Nothing. That's a CLEAN flip.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He's already building the business, Barry. That's a man who's truly empty.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Is this where my son sent the T V? <p:0.3> He mailed away the family television. To a Box.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Your son is flatlining beautifully, flatliner.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: He won't come to dinner anymore. He just sits and stares at the wall where the T V was.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: He is watching the nothing, flatliner. That's the premium channel.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hollis, where does all of it GO? The piano, the dog, the T V, where does the stuff people mail away actually end up?

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: It goes to the address, flatliner. <p:0.3> One address. All boxes. <p:0.3> You mail your Box to the address too, eventually. The seal completes.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. They mail the EMPTY box back to YOU?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I mailed mine back FULL, Barry! I put my OTHER stuff INSIDE the empty box first, to make it MORE nothing!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's not more nothing, Patricia, that's a box of your things going to a stranger's house!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Wait, so the address RECEIVES full boxes and SHIPS empty ones? <p:0.3> He's net positive on stuff! Hollis, I want in on the INBOUND side!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Is my son's T V at the address? Can I have the address?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I feel SO nothing about my piano being gone, it's the BEST I've EVER felt!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: INBOUND!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Dinner!

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Leak. Leak. <p:0.3> Leak.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: EVERYBODY just, STOP. <p:0.3> Ronnie, we have a Box in the studio. The promo one. I am going to open it and end this.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Go ahead, Barry. Show them the nothing.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay. I'm shaking it. <p:0.4> Hold on. <p:0.3> Something's, there's something in here. It RATTLES.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Impossible, flatliner. The box is verified empty.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Oh, that. <p:0.3> Yeah, during the break I flatlined the whole studio, Barry. Signed us all up. Premium. <p:0.4> I had to mail in something of everyone's, so.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.3> These are my CAR KEYS. My car keys are rattling in the nothing box.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: A leak. <p:0.3> Released, flatliner.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's not a leak, Ronnie, that's grand theft.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Feel nothing about it, flatliner.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And that's our hour. The Box ships to one address, Barry, so technically your keys are already on the way. <p:0.4> Stay flat, folks. We'll be right back, after this very empty word from our sponsor.
